initial_arguments.name: M2 — Customer CSV Data Processing
initial_arguments.details: Build the ingestion and processing pipeline for customer CSV files: schema detection, validation, normalization, deduplication, and transformation into the shared analytics model. Includes handling malformed rows, encoding issues, and large file streaming.

initial_arguments.name: M3 — Application Log Analysis
initial_arguments.details: Build the log ingestion and analysis pipeline: parse structured and semi-structured application logs, extract severity/timestamps/services, compute aggregation metrics (error rates, latency buckets), and produce the log telemetry dataset consumed by the dashboard.

initial_arguments.name: M4 — Data Storage & Modeling
initial_arguments.details: Define and implement the storage layer and analytical data model that both pipelines write into and visualizations read from. Covers table/collection design, indexing strategy, query layer, and caching approach for dashboard responsiveness.

initial_arguments.name: M5 — Visualization Component Library
initial_arguments.details: Build the reusable visualization component library: chart primitives, data-bound wrappers, shared theming, responsive layout behavior, and accessibility support. Components must consume the shared data model from M4.

initial_arguments.name: M6 — Dashboard Integration & Assembly
initial_arguments.details: Assemble the dashboard application: routing/shell layout, wiring visualization components to live data queries, global filters (date range, customer segment, service), drill-down interactions, and loading/error states.

initial_arguments.name: M7 — Testing, QA & Deployment
initial_arguments.details: Validate the full system: unit and integration tests for both pipelines, visual regression checks, performance validation on realistic data volumes, and deployment/rollout configuration.

Define the canonical analytics entities (Customer, CustomerEvent, LogEntry, ServiceMetric) as typed schemas/interfaces shared by both pipelines and the UI layer. Include field types, nullability, enums, and versioning rules. Deliverable: committed schema definitions plus a short contract doc.
initial_arguments.name: M1.3 Define shared data contracts and analytics schema

args.name: M2.2 Build row validation and quarantine

initial_arguments.details: Implement per-row validation rules (required fields, type coercion, date/email/numeric formats) with a quarantine sink for rejected rows and a per-run rejection report. Deliverable: validator module with unit tests and a rejection-rate report.
initial_arguments.name: M2.2 Implement row validation and quarantine handling

args.name: M2.3 Normalize rows to analytics model

initial_arguments.details: Convert validated rows into the canonical Customer/CustomerEvent entities: trim and case-normalize strings, standardize date/time to UTC ISO-8601, normalize addresses and phone formats, and coerce currency/numeric fields. Deliverable: transform module with golden-file tests.
initial_arguments.name: M2.3 Normalize and transform rows into the analytics model
M2.4 Implement customer deduplication and identity resolution
initial_arguments.details: Detect and merge duplicate customer records using deterministic keys (normalized email + external ID) and a documented merge precedence rule. Emit a duplicate report for review. Deliverable: dedup module plus tests for exact and near-duplicate cases.

initial_arguments.name: M2.5 Add streaming ingestion and encoding/delimiter handling
initial_arguments.details: Replace whole-file loading with a streaming reader so multi-hundred-MB CSVs stay within memory limits. Detect BOM, UTF-8 vs Latin-1 encoding, and comma/semicolon/tab delimiters. Deliverable: streaming reader with a benchmark against a 200MB fixture.

initial_arguments.name: M2.6 Implement pipeline orchestration and idempotent reruns
initial_arguments.details: Wire the CSV stages (detect → validate → normalize → dedup → load) into a single orchestrator with a run ledger, checkpointing, and idempotent rerun semantics keyed on file hash. Deliverable: orchestrator entrypoint plus a re-run test proving no duplicate loads.

initial_arguments.name: M3.2 Build plaintext and semi-structured log parser with fallbacks
initial_arguments.details: Implement regex/token-based parsing for plaintext and semi-structured log lines, with a graceful fallback that preserves the raw message when a pattern does not match instead of dropping the record. Deliverable: parser with a coverage report showing matched vs unmatched line counts.

initial_arguments.name: M3.4 Compute log aggregation metrics (error rate, latency, volume)
initial_arguments.details: Compute the metrics the dashboard needs: error/warn rate per service per time bucket, request latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) where durations are present, and log volume over time. Deliverable: aggregation module writing ServiceMetric records plus validation against a hand-computed sample.

initial_arguments.name: M4.3 Build the query/service API layer for dashboard views
initial_arguments.details: Expose read endpoints that each visualization needs (customer metrics by segment, log metrics by service and bucket), with typed request/response DTOs, pagination, and input validation. Deliverable: API routes with contract tests per endpoint.

args.name: M5.3 Build time-series chart component
args.details: Create a time-series chart component with selectable granularity (hour/day/week), consistent axis formatting, and tooltip values. Deliverable: component with prop-driven data plus tests for granularity switching and tick formatting.

initial_arguments.name: M5.3 Build time-series chart and KPI metric card components
initial_arguments.details: Create the two dashboard-specific components: a time-series chart with selectable granularity (hour/day/week) and a KPI card showing value, delta vs previous period, and sparkline. Deliverable: both components with prop-driven data and unit tests for delta formatting.

args.name: M6.4 Add global filters and drill-downs

initial_arguments.name: M6.4 Implement global filters and drill-down interactions
initial_arguments.details: Add the shared filter bar (date range presets, customer segment, service selector) held in URL query state so filters survive refresh and are shareable, plus click-to-drill-down from chart segments into detail lists. Deliverable: filters affecting all panels, with URL-state tests.

initial_arguments.name: M7.3 Add end-to-end integration tests from ingestion to rendered dashboard
initial_arguments.details: Seed a test database from small CSV and log fixtures, run both pipelines, boot the app, and assert that expected KPI values and chart series appear on each page. Deliverable: E2E suite covering both data domains plus filter interactions.

initial_arguments.name: M7.4 Run performance and load validation on realistic data volumes
initial_arguments.details: Benchmark pipeline throughput on a realistic multi-GB log set and a large customer CSV, and measure dashboard p95 response time under concurrent users. Compare against the M1.4 targets. Deliverable: performance report with bottlenecks and any needed tuning tasks identified.
